Let’s try to narrow it down. Based on your memory — a PDF editor whose name started with an **X** — here are a few possibilities that might be the one you used:

---

### 🟢 **Likely Candidates**
#### 1. **Xodo PDF Reader & Editor**
- **Platform**: Android, iOS, Web, Windows
- **Notable for**: Clean interface, annotation tools, filling forms, signing PDFs
- **URL**: [https://www.xodo.com](https://www.xodo.com)
- **Commonly pre-installed or recommended on Android tablets & phones**

> 🔥 **Most likely match** if you're using Android.

#### 2. **PDF-XChange Editor**
- **Platform**: Windows
- **Notable for**: Lightweight, advanced annotation, OCR, digital signatures
- **Developer**: Tracker Software
- **URL**: [https://www.tracker-software.com/product/pdf-xchange-editor](https://www.tracker-software.com/product/pdf-xchange-editor)

> ⚙️ A very popular **Windows desktop** PDF editor starting with "X".

---

### 🟡 Less Likely but Possible
#### 3. **Xournal / Xournal++**
- **Platform**: Linux, Windows, macOS
- **Notable for**: Handwriting notes, PDF annotation, stylus support
- **URL**: [https://github.com/xournalpp/xournalpp](https://github.com/xournalpp/xournalpp)

> ✍️ More focused on note-taking and annotating over PDFs.

#### 4. **Foxit PDF Editor**
- **Originally called** Foxit **Reader**, but it sometimes shows up in searches as “Foxit PhantomPDF” — and could be misremembered as starting with X.
- **URL**: [https://www.foxit.com/pdf-editor/](https://www.foxit.com/pdf-editor/)

---

### ❓ Questions to Pin It Down Further
- Was it on Android, Windows, or Mac?
- Did it let you **edit text directly**, or mostly annotate?
- Do you remember the icon color or what it looked like?
